description.text: Golden Gate Ventures is an international venture capital firm investing in high-growth markets across Asia and the Middle East. Founded in 2011 and headquartered in Singapore, the firm combines the knowledge and experience of Silicon Valley with deep, on-the-ground roots in emerging startup ecosystems. For more than a decade, Golden Gate Ventures has earned the trust of founders through long-term partnership and support beyond capital, while also strengthening the startup ecosystems it operates in. The firm manages over US$300M and has invested in more than 150 companies, including 9 unicorns and 2 IPOs across its portfolio, with notable companies including Carro, Stripe, Tarjama, Coda, Xendit, AngelList, and Multiplier.
